title: Shift compatibility of the canonical derived tensor comparison
statement: For an exact additive strong monoidal left adjoint preserving flat objects between Grothendieck abelian braided closed monoidal categories admitting functorial flat resolutions, the canonical derived tensor comparison commutes with shifts whenever the left-derived counit does. Its canonical unit is invertible and its comparison is oplax monoidal. The canonical tensor is [def-weil-derived-tensor].

source.place: Monoidal localization construction; UpperStarMonoidal/Shift.lean, flat-resolution shift argument.

proof.text: Compute the comparison on a flat resolution using its universal counit. The tensor shift comparison applies on these representatives; naturality transports the result along the resolution isomorphism. The existing oplax-of-lax-square construction proves monoidal coherence; the unit is the composite of the derived counit on the unit and the ordinary unit comparisons, all invertible.
